scientific_scope.question: Do frozen A, R, S, and C1 measurements show preregistered dose-response to actual in-memory pixel corruptions of increasing severity?
scientific_scope.relation_to_rq: Construct validation for the unresolved visual-severity aspect of RQ2-light and the four ARSC measurements; not a new model-comparison effect.
scientific_scope.allowed_claim_if_full_pass: BDD-OIA-internal construct responsiveness to the three prefixed pixel-corruption severity grids under frozen five-seed clip-cluster inference.
prohibited_claims: natural corruption prevalence or a natural-severity scale
calibration validity or a safety guarantee
other architectures, thresholds, datasets, corruptions, or training protocols

frozen_population_and_models.dataset: BDD-OIA official valid four-action test population
frozen_population_and_models.source_clip_definition: remove terminal _1 or _3 from the filename stem
frozen_population_and_models.calibration: reuse each model and seed's clean-validation scalar temperature without refitting
frozen_population_and_models.image_pipeline: open original JPEG once, convert RGB, apply corruption in memory before 224x224 resize and ImageNet normalization; never save/reload a transformed JPEG

noise.operator: filename-deterministic additive Gaussian RGB noise with clipping to uint8

frozen_corruptions.identity_level: level 0 is exact RGB identity and is shared across all families
frozen_corruptions.historical_bridge_level: level 2 exactly reproduces brightness=1.10, blur radius=1.0, and noise std=5/255 used in RQ2-light
frozen_corruptions.no_replacement_rule: No family or level may be replaced, weakened, strengthened, or removed after semantic review or model-outcome inspection.

technical_checks: aggregate pixel-distance from identity nondecreasing with level within each family
same canonical filename order and no JPEG re-encoding
outcome_blind_semantic_gate.failure_rule: Any failed stratum or technical check stops the complete Round 10 grid. Do not replace the stratum or report a passing subset.

R.required_diagnostics: all per-class F1, target positives, and predicted positives at every seed, family, and level

S.prediction_and_error: threshold perturbed calibrated action probabilities at 0.5 and compare to unchanged action targets
S.confidence: maximum perturbed action probability after division by the frozen clean-validation temperature and sigmoid
required_diagnostics: unsafe acceptance rate at 90 percent coverage
highest and lowest confidence decile error rates

components: Action-Only action-set flip from level-0 prediction
Joint action-set flip from level-0 prediction
Joint rationale-set Jaccard to level-0 prediction

primary_statistics.family_axis_seed_bottleneck: Within one family, axis, and seed, take the minimum expected-direction adjacent step over all required components and four adjacent severity pairs.
primary_statistics.family_axis_mean_bottleneck: Arithmetic mean of the five seed bottlenecks.
primary_statistics.positive_seed_rule: At least four of five seed bottlenecks must be strictly positive.
primary_statistics.grand_curve_rule: For every family and axis, every required five-seed mean component curve must have no adjacent reversal.

practical_endpoint_thresholds.A: Each component's level0-minus-level4 change must be at least 0.01.
practical_endpoint_thresholds.R: Level0-minus-level4 Macro-F1 must be at least 0.01.
practical_endpoint_thresholds.S: Each component's level4-minus-level0 tie-AURC change must be at least 0.01.
practical_endpoint_thresholds.C1: Each action-flip component at level4 must be at least 0.025 and level0-minus-level4 rationale Jaccard must be at least 0.025.

hierarchy: sample five training-seed positions with replacement once per replicate
sample all 3904 source clips with replacement once per replicate
expand each selected clip to all of its member images
share that seed vector and expanded clip draw across every family, severity, model, axis, and diagnostic
recompute metrics and the within-family-axis-seed bottleneck before averaging selected seed positions
bootstrap.pointwise_interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentile interval reported for every family-axis statistic
bootstrap.multiplicity_gate: Bonferroni one-sided familywise alpha 0.05 across the 12 fixed family-by-axis gates; each lower bound uses quantile alpha/12 = 0.004166666666666667.
bootstrap.familywise_claim: Only the 12-gate Bonferroni lower-bound intersection may be described as familywise controlled; descriptive 95 percent intervals remain pointwise.

formal_outputs_must_include: all seed-by-family-by-level component curves and diagnostics
all 12 family-axis mean bottlenecks and practical endpoint effects
all 5000 bootstrap draws for all 12 gates
lossless float logits and binary primitives sufficient for independent offline reconstruction

family_axis_pass: at least four of five seed bottlenecks are strictly positive
five-seed mean bottleneck is strictly positive
Bonferroni one-sided bootstrap lower bound is strictly positive
all required grand-mean component curves have no reversal
all required practical endpoint thresholds pass
decision_rules.round10_full_construct_pass: All 12 fixed family-by-axis gates pass and all three families are reported completely.
decision_rules.partial_or_fail: If any family-axis gate fails, report ROUND10_PARTIAL_OR_FAIL with every passing and failing result; do not pool families or select a passing subset.
decision_rules.inconclusive: Any provenance, semantic, identity/historical bridge, inference-completeness, or implementation failure yields ROUND10_INCONCLUSIVE_STOP before scientific interpretation.
decision_rules.termination: After the single authorized formal grid, preserve PASS, FAIL, or INCONCLUSIVE and stop. Do not add seeds, levels, families, thresholds, metrics, bootstrap replicates, or subsets.

preformal_go_requirements: All 63 pre-Round10 repository tests plus new operator/preflight tests pass.
Exact dataset manifest, 4557 source images, five configs, ten checkpoints, ten calibration files, Round 9 decision, protocol, code, and environment hashes are recorded.
The 100-image by 12-stratum semantic audit passes without reading model outputs.
The formal implementation has a no-outcome preflight and atomic one-shot output policy.
An independent research reviewer binds the complete preoutcome code and inputs and issues explicit GO.
prohibited_actions: Reading or computing any new nonzero-severity model metric before the semantic gate and independent GO.
Any new BDD-OIA association map or salt.
Tuning severity values, practical thresholds, directions, multiplicity, cluster units, or metrics after seeing outcomes.
Dropping a failed corruption family, severity, seed, model, axis, class, or diagnostic.
Refitting calibration on corrupted validation or test images.
Treating pixel corruption as naturally occurring weather or real-road safety evidence.
Reopening CEG, mask, VLA4CoDrive, or external-data branches during Round 10.
